questions.q: When is the reservations inbox checked?
questions.gold: Daily at 9 a.m. and 5 p.m. Eastern

questions.q: May you confirm a booking for 3 rooms yourself?

questions.gold: Approval from sales manager Olivia Grant

questions.gold: Do not give it; offer to pass on a message

questions.gold: Tell them to leave by the nearest stairway, not the elevator; call 911 yourself; then text night manager Sam Ortiz
